intent: Integrate the approved Needle opening, image-only wall, category map and contextual navigation while preserving the deployed images, corpus, search and existing commands. Keep secondary tools reachable and ship only to test.

findings.suggested_fix: Add a target guard to the keydown branch so Enter calls submitted() only when event.target matches the Composer input; retain the existing click capture for .search-composer__submit. Verify Enter on Clear leaves the opening route unchanged and clears the query, while Enter in the input and keyboard activation of Search still navigate.
findings.title: Restrict Enter navigation to actual search submissions
findings.why_it_matters: Keyboard users who type on the opening screen and press Enter on Clear search are unexpectedly sent to the results screen. The wrapper captures every Enter inside the Composer, while the deployed Clear button only edits the draft; an in-memory execution of the authored JSX confirmed that this event queues a results navigation without a runtime submit. Restricting keyboard capture to the input preserves the existing clear behavior, while the existing submit-click capture already handles keyboard activation of the Search button.

findings.suggested_fix: While home is active, subscribe measure to captured window scroll events and remove the listener in cleanup, matching QueryFilterMenu's positioning pattern. Include visualViewport resize/scroll updates if retaining fixed viewport positioning, and verify the opening panel at a short landscape viewport while scrolling.
findings.title: Scrolling the opening page detaches its search input
findings.why_it_matters: On a short or landscape viewport, scrolling the opening panel moves its placeholder while the actual search input stays at its previous viewport coordinates. The input can cover the examples or heading instead of its reserved space. Its position is measured from getBoundingClientRect(), but scrolling changes that rectangle without resizing the observed slot; updating the measurement on captured scroll events keeps the fixed input aligned.

findings.title: Remove inert before restoring tools opener focus
findings.why_it_matters: Closing Search tools with Escape or its close button fails to return keyboard focus to the Search tools opener. The layout effect calls focus while the header is still inert; the passive effect only removes inert afterward, and the saved focus target has already been cleared. Restore interactivity before restoring focus so keyboard users resume at the control that opened the dialog.

findings.suggested_fix: Extend the advanced map click bridge to queue openArtwork for .query-node clicks only when state.queryArtworkId is non-null, alongside the existing [data-artwork-id] case. Verify a local artwork reference recipe opens the source inspector, and text/upload-only query nodes do not open an empty dialog.
findings.title: Open details for the semantic query artwork
findings.why_it_matters: In local experimental mode, an artwork-only recipe shows its source artwork in the semantic map's Your query button, but clicking that image no longer opens its details. QueryNode selects the artwork through the deployed callback but has no data-artwork-id, so the new modal bridge ignores the click; the legacy inspector was always mounted and responded to the same selection. Handling a query-node click when queryArtworkId identifies a real corpus artwork restores that existing inspection action without opening empty dialogs for text or uploaded queries.

validator_batch.reason: The wrapper captures Enter from every descendant, including Clear, and queues results navigation before the Clear button click edits the draft.
Navigation restores only presentation state while runtime startup executes the default search, and InspectorPanel reads runtime selection without restoration of the opened artwork ID.
The fixed search position uses the slot viewport rectangle but updates only on resize, while scrolling home moves the slot without resizing it.
The focus-restoration layout effect runs while the opener header remains inert until passive-effect cleanup, then clears the saved focus target.
The cited tests omit this event boundary, but missing integration coverage alone does not establish defective behavior in the cited capture handler.
Results-to-map-to-logo pushes results over map, so history.back returns to map while the page labels the action Back to search.
QueryNode selects its corpus artwork but lacks data-artwork-id, so the new click bridge does not open its artwork inspector.

validator_dropped.reason: Missing integration coverage alone did not establish a defect; not retained as a primary finding or recycled as an advisory claim.
